column3: ¡Te han castigado! ¡Eso te enseñará!

column4: So, you finally got caught shoplifting! That'll teach you not to do it again!

column4: I heard that Tom finally got a speeding ticket! That taught him a lesson!

column4: Don't tell me you did it again! Honestly, are you ever going to learn?

column4: Are you telling me that you got arrested yet again? Seriously, are you ever going to learn?

column4: When are you going to learn that money doesn't grow on trees?
